records.text: The word of the Lord that came to Hosea son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel.

The beginning of the Lord’s word to Hosea. The Lord said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a woman of prostitution and children of prostitution, for the land will utterly prostitute itself away from following the Lord.”
He went and took Gomer daughter of Debelaim; she conceived and bore him a son.
The Lord said to him, “Call him Jezreel, for in a little while I will avenge Jezreel’s blood upon Jehu’s house and put an end to the kingdom of Israel’s house.
On that day I will shatter Israel’s bow in the Valley of Jezreel.”
She conceived again and bore a daughter. He said to him, “Call her Not Shown Mercy, for I will certainly no longer show mercy to Israel’s house, but I will surely set Myself against them.
But I will show mercy to Judah’s sons and save them by the Lord their God. I will not save them by bow, sword, war, chariots, horses or horsemen.”
She weaned Not Shown Mercy, conceived again and bore a son.
He said, “Call him Not My People, for you are not My people, and I am not yours.”

The number of Israel’s sons was like the sand of the sea, which will not be measured or counted. In the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ there they will be called sons of the living God.
Judah’s sons and Israel’s sons will gather together, appoint one authority for themselves and come up from the land, for great is Jezreel’s day.
Say to your brother, ‘My People,’ and to your sister, ‘Shown Mercy.’
“Enter into judgment with your mother, enter into judgment! For she is not My wife and I am not her husband. I will remove her prostitution from My face and her adultery from between her breasts,
so that I may strip her naked and restore her as on the day of her birth. I will make her like a wilderness, set her like a waterless land and kill her with thirst.
I will certainly show no mercy to her children, for they are children of prostitution.

For their mother prostituted herself; she who bore them brought shame. She said, ‘I will follow my lovers, who give me my loaves and water, my garments and linen cloths, my oil and everything due to me.’
Therefore look, I block her way with thorns and will build up her roads, and she will certainly not find her path.

She will pursue her lovers but certainly not catch them; she will seek them but certainly not find them. She will say, ‘I will go and return to my former husband, for it was better for me then than now.’
She did not know that it was I who gave her grain, wine and oil and multiplied silver for her; but she made silver and gold objects for Baal.
Therefore I will return and recover My grain at its season and My wine at its time; I will take away My garments and linen cloths so that they do not cover her shame.
Now I will uncover her uncleanness before her lovers, and certainly no one will deliver her from My hand.
I will turn away all her rejoicings, her festivals, new moons and Sabbaths, and all her festal assemblies.

I will obliterate her vine and fig trees, of which she said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers gave me.’ I will make them a testimony, and the field’s beasts, heaven’s birds and the earth’s creeping things will devour them.”
“I will exact vengeance upon her for the days of the Baalim, when she sacrificed to them, put on her earrings and necklaces and went after her lovers, but forgot Me,” says the Lord.
“Therefore look, I am leading her astray; I will place her in a wilderness and speak to her heart,
and from there I will give her her possessions and the Valley of Achor to open her understanding. There she will be humbled as in the days of her infancy and the days of her ascent from Egypt’s land.
On that day,” says the Lord, “she will call Me ‘My Husband’ and no longer call Me ‘Baalim.’
I will remove the names of the Baalim from her mouth, and they will certainly no longer remember their names.
On that day I will establish a covenant for them with the field’s beasts, heaven’s birds and the earth’s creeping things. I will shatter bow, sword and war from the land and settle you in hope.
I will betroth you to Myself forever; I will betroth you to Myself in righteousness and judgment, in mercy and compassion,
and I will betroth you to Myself in faithfulness, and you will know the Lord.
On that day,” says the Lord, “I will listen to heaven, and heaven will listen to the earth,
and the earth will listen to grain, wine and oil, and they will listen to Jezreel.
I will sow her for Myself upon the land, show mercy to Not Shown Mercy and say to Not My People, ‘You are My people.’ He will say, ‘Thou art the Lord my God!’”
The Lord said to me, “Go again and love a woman who loves evil things and is an adulteress, just as God loves Israel’s sons, though they look toward foreign gods and love cakes with raisins.”
I hired her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver, a gomor of barley and a nebel of wine.
I said to her, “You will remain with me many days; you must certainly not prostitute yourself or belong to another man, and I toward you.”
For Israel’s sons will remain many days without king or ruler, without sacrifice or altar, without priesthood or manifestations.
After these things Israel’s sons will return and seek the Lord their God and David their king; they will be astonished at the Lord and His good things in the last days.
Hear the Lord’s word, sons of Israel, for the Lord has a case against the land’s inhabitants: there is no truth, no mercy and no recognition of God upon the land.
Cursing, falsehood, murder, theft and adultery have poured over the land, and they mix bloodshed with bloodshed.
Therefore the land will mourn and diminish with all who inhabit it, with the field’s beasts, the earth’s creeping things and heaven’s birds; the sea’s fish will disappear,
so that no one brings a case and no one rebukes; but My people are like a priest being contradicted.
You will grow weak by day, and a prophet will also grow weak with you; I likened your mother to night.

My people were likened to one without knowledge. Because you thrust away recognition, I too will thrust you away from serving Me as priest. You forgot your God’s law, and I too will forget your children.
According to their multitude, so they sinned against Me; I will turn their glory into dishonor.
They will eat My people’s sins and take their souls amid their injustices.
It will be as with the people, so with the priest; I will exact punishment upon him for his ways and repay him for his schemes.
They will eat but certainly not be filled; they prostituted themselves but will certainly not prosper, because they abandoned keeping faith with the Lord.
My people’s heart welcomed prostitution, wine and intoxicating drink.
They inquired by signs, and by his rods they announced things to him; they were led astray by a spirit of prostitution and prostituted themselves away from their God.

On the mountaintops they sacrificed, and on the hills they offered sacrifice, beneath oak, poplar and a tree providing shade, because shelter is good. Therefore your daughters will prostitute themselves and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.

I will certainly not call your daughters to account when they prostitute themselves, or your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery, for the men themselves mixed with prostitutes and sacrificed with initiates; the people who understood became entangled with a prostitute.
But you, Israel, do not be ignorant; and Judah, do not enter Gilgal or go up to the house of On, and do not swear by the living Lord.
For Israel has run wild like a heifer running wild. Now the Lord will pasture them like a lamb in an open place.
Ephraim, a partner of idols, set stumbling blocks for himself.
He chose Canaanites. They prostituted themselves thoroughly; they loved dishonor arising from their arrogance.
You are a whirlwind within its wings, and they will be put to shame because of their altars.
Hear these things, priests; pay attention, house of Israel; listen, house of the king, for the judgment is against you. You became a trap at the lookout and like a net stretched over Itabyrion,
which those hunting game fixed in place. But I am your instructor.
I know Ephraim, and Israel is not away from Me; for now Ephraim has prostituted himself and Israel is defiled.
They did not direct their schemes toward returning to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them, and they did not recognize the Lord.
Israel’s arrogance will be humbled before his face. Israel and Ephraim will weaken in their injustices, and Judah too will weaken with them.
With sheep and calves they will go to seek the Lord, but they will certainly not find Him, because He turned away from them,
because they abandoned the Lord, because foreign children were born to them. Now blight will devour them and their allotments.
Blow a trumpet on the hills; sound out on the heights; proclaim in the house of On! Benjamin was beside himself;
Ephraim was brought to ruin in days of rebuke. Among Israel’s tribes I revealed trustworthy things.
Judah’s rulers became like people moving boundaries; upon them I will pour My onrush like water.
Ephraim oppressed his adversary and trampled judgment, because he began to follow worthless things.
I am like turmoil to Ephraim and like a goad to Judah’s house.
Ephraim saw his illness and Judah his pain; Ephraim went to the Assyrians and sent ambassadors to King Jarim. But he could not heal you, and pain will certainly not cease among you.
For I am like a panther to Ephraim and like a lion to Judah’s house. I seize and will go away and take, and there will be no one to rescue.
I will go and return to My place until they disappear; they will seek My face, and in their affliction they will rise early toward Me, saying,
